استعيضا (form X)
# اُسْتُعِيضَا (ustuʕīḍā) /us.tu.ʕiː.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
# اِسْتَعِيضَا (istaʕīḍā) /is.ta.ʕiː.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
